therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: neuroprotection via improved cerebral glucose metabolism
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with amnestic mild cognitive impairment
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in Total Recall Score in the Selective Reminding Test and Change in ADAS-cog score at 12 months

results.effect_size: SRT total recall: mean difference 3.7 (t-test, p=0.05); ADAS-cog: mean difference 1.98 (t-test, p=0.06), 0.9 (ANCOVA, p=0.34)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Change in relative cerebral glucose uptake (rCMRgl) in posterior cingulate-precuneus: +2.0% in metformin vs 0.0% in placebo (p=0.36)
biomarker_changes: Plasma Amyloid beta-42 change: +0.69 pg/ml (metformin) vs -4.40 pg/ml (placebo), mean difference 5.09 pg/ml, p=0.34
rCMRgl in posterior cingulate-precuneus: +2.0% (metformin) vs 0.0% (placebo), p=0.36

dose_info.schedule: twice daily, titrated from 500 mg once daily
dose_info.dose_modifications: Titrated from 500 mg once daily up to 1000 mg twice daily
